newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNT plans HK$320-345 mln bus unit spinoff.
newsitem.headline: CNT plans HK$320-345 mln bus unit spinoff.

text.p: CNT Group Ltd said on Friday it plans to seek a separate listing of its unit Citybus Group Ltd by issuing 250 million new Citybus shares for an estimated HK$320-345 million before expenses.
The new share issue will represent about 25 percent of the bus operator's enlarged issued share capital, it said.
Citybus will make a preferential offer to CNT shareholders, who will be granted an opportunity to apply, on an assured basis, for one Citybus share for every ten CNT shares.
It said overseas shareholders and those with less than 2,000 CNT shares will not be entitled to participate in the offer.
CNT noted it has diversified into property development and investment and public bus services from its original business of the manufacture and sale of paint.

A separate listing would allow its Citybus unit to continue to expand its bus operations and improving the fund-raising capacity of both Citybus and CNT and improve the management focus on both businesses, it added.
Dealing of Citybus shares is expected to commence on November 29.
